title: Titan’s New Methane Lake Found 1,500 km From Equator

scenes.text: Cassini spotted a fresh methane lake 1,500 km from Titan’s equator

scenes.label: FIRST NEW LAKE SINCE 2
scenes.text: The lake, named Ligeia, is the first new surface lake discovered since 2011.

scenes.label: SECOND LAYER OF METHAN
scenes.text: Radar data shows a second, deeper methane layer beneath the surface.

scenes.label: THIRD WITH SHALLOW MOU
scenes.text: The surrounding terrain includes shallow dunes and small mountains, unique among Titan lakes.
Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: Cassini’s final flyby revealed a new methane lake on Titan, 1,500 km from the equator, adding fresh detail to this icy moon’s complex hydrology. Follow for daily science!
